name: Dynamic Neural Radiance Fields
aliases: Dynamic Neural Radiance Field (Dynamic NeRF) for Facial Avatars
Dynamic Neural Radiance Fields for Monocular 4D Facial Avatar Reconstruction
definition: A method to reconstruct a 4D facial avatar from monocular video by representing the scene as a dynamic neural radiance field conditioned on facial expressions and head pose, allowing for novel view synthesis and expression editing.
summary: Dynamic Neural Radiance Fields model facial dynamics from monocular video by conditioning a neural network on expression parameters and latent codes, enabling novel viewpoint synthesis without multi-view rigs.
